title: Kotoba classic landmark & audio ducking
changes: Added Kotoba Colosseum to the Classic Activity Landmarks path alongside the existing landmark cards.
Reduced Colosseum background music to a lower normal level and ducks it to near-silent while Japanese word audio or speech synthesis is playing.
Restores the music gently after the Japanese word finishes.
Retains the v11.3.3 in-place answer feedback, transparent sprites and stop-music-on-exit fixes.
Bumped all release-controlled asset and service-worker cache versions to v11.3.4.
